title: AI Engineer (LLM Systems)
description:
Build the agents, RAG platforms, and evaluation harnesses our enterprise clients actually run — production AI, not demo AI.

  

 Noida, India Full\-time Hybrid 3–7 years
The role
Our AI practice ships systems with audit trails, cost ceilings, and evaluation gates — the unglamorous engineering that separates production AI from conference demos. You'll build RAG pipelines over messy enterprise data, agents that execute real workflows, and the harnesses that prove they work.


You should be the kind of engineer who asks 'how do we know it's right?' before 'which model should we use?'


**What you will do**
--------------------


* Design and ship LLM applications: RAG platforms, copilots, document intelligence, agents
* Build evaluation suites that gate releases on accuracy, safety, latency, and cost
* Engineer data boundaries: what leaves the client's environment and what never can
* Integrate AI into enterprise systems through governed, least\-privilege interfaces
* Track the model landscape and translate it into client\-ready recommendations
**What we are looking for**
---------------------------


* 3\+ years software engineering with strong Python or TypeScript
* Shipped LLM features beyond prototypes: retrieval, orchestration, evaluation
* Working knowledge of embeddings, vector stores, and prompt/context engineering
* Clear writing — your design docs get read by client architects
**Nice to have**
----------------


* LangGraph or similar agent frameworks in production
* Fine\-tuning and model\-serving experience (vLLM, GPU infra)
* Classic ML background (forecasting, classification)

description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

* Technical Leadership and Delivery
	+ Lead complex data engineering workstreams from intake through production release, balancing delivery velocity, architectural quality, and measurable business outcomes
	+ Provide hands\-on technical direction to junior engineers and peer developers, including design reviews, code reviews, delivery sequencing, and issue resolution
	+ Translate finance analytics, reporting, and AI/ML requirements into scalable data engineering designs, implementation plans, and release\-ready solutions
* Pipeline Engineering and Data Platform Modernization
	+ Architect, build, and maintain distributed data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Spark/PySpark, SQL, Python, Snowflake, and Databricks to process large\-scale batch and streaming datasets
	+ Migrate legacy relational or warehouse\-based pipelines to cloud\-native and distributed architectures that improve performance, scalability, resiliency, and cost efficiency
	+ Design and implement data lake and lakehouse patterns that support raw, curated, and consumption\-layer datasets for analytics, reporting, and downstream AI/ML use cases

	+ Design and support cloud infrastructure patterns for data engineering workloads, including Azure Data Lake, storage organization, compute configuration, network\-aware platform integration, environment promotion, and secure service connectivity
	+ Partner with cloud infrastructure, security, and architecture teams to ensure data platforms follow enterprise standards for identity, access control, secrets management, monitoring, scalability, and resiliency
	+ Apply infrastructure\-as\-code, environment configuration, deployment automation, and platform reliability practices where appropriate to improve repeatability, auditability, and operational support
* Orchestration, Automation, Reliability, and DevOps
	+ Implement monitoring, alerting, error handling, runbooks, and incident triage practices that improve pipeline reliability and reduce operational overhead
	+ Apply CI/CD best practices using Azure DevOps, GitHub, or equivalent tooling, including source control, automated testing, code review, release management, and controlled environment promotion
	+ Optimize pipeline performance and cloud consumption through capacity\-aware design, scheduling strategy, partitioning, compute right\-sizing, and cost\-conscious engineering decisions
* Data Modeling, Governance, and Quality
	+ Design scalable data models and transformation patterns that support trusted finance data products across raw, curated, and consumption layers
	+ Establish data contracts, SLAs, validation rules, reconciliation checks, and data quality controls to ensure consistency and trust across downstream consumers
	+ Support secure and compliant handling of sensitive finance data, including access patterns, governance alignment, auditability, metadata documentation, and controlled release processes
* Stakeholder Collaboration and Analytics Enablement
	+ Collaborate with finance business partners, analytics teams, architects, product owners, and platform teams to prioritize work, resolve dependencies, and communicate delivery status and risks
	+ Enable analytics and AI/ML solutions by ensuring curated datasets are reliable, discoverable, performant, and fit for downstream reporting, modeling, and decision\-support use cases
  

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re\-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, analytics, cloud engineering, or a related field
* 6\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, cloud data platforms, or data platform development, with demonstrated ability to lead technical workstreams or mentor junior engineers
* Solid hands\-on experience designing, building, and supporting large\-scale cloud\-based data platforms using Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and Python
* Experience with cloud infrastructure concepts relevant to data engineering workloads, including storage, compute, networking considerations, identity/access management, secrets management, observability, scalability, resiliency, and cost optimization
* Experience implementing modern engineering practices such as source control, CI/CD, automated testing, code reviews, release management, infrastructure\-as\-code, environment promotion, and operational runbooks
* Solid knowledge of data modeling, ETL/ELT development, orchestration, performance tuning, data quality frameworks, secure data handling, metadata documentation, and governance\-aligned delivery
* Proven ability to work directly with business partners, analytics teams, architects, platform teams, and engineering resources to clarify requirements, document data mappings, communicate risks, coordinate testing, and deliver measurable outcomes

We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: IT Applications Engineer - Technology IT
description:
About Signant Health
  
At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
  
Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
  
If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
  
  

About the Role
  
The IT Applications Engineer is a generalist engineering and support role responsible for the day\-to\-day administration, configuration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of Signant Health's core business applications. The role carries particular depth in NetSuite, Microsoft 365, Box, and Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence), while also supporting the broader enterprise application portfolio as needed.
  
This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor role that blends technical engineering — configuration, scripting, integrations, automations, and upgrades — with day\-to\-day operational support — tickets, incidents, and user requests. The IT Applications Engineer is a trusted first\- and second\-line point of contact for application issues, and is equally comfortable delivering enhancements and automations that improve reliability and reduce manual effort across the application landscape. Where the IT Application Operations Manager sets direction and leads the team, this role does the technical and support work directly, partnering closely with the Service Operations, Infrastructure Operations, and Security Operations teams.
  
  

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES \- Function
  
1\. Application Administration \& Configuration — Own day\-to\-day administration and configuration of NetSuite, Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, Entra ID), Box, and Atlassian (Jira, JSM, Confluence), plus other assigned enterprise applications, including user provisioning, permissions, and platform settings.
  
2\. Technical Support \& Incident Resolution — Act as a key point of escalation for tier 2/3 application support tickets, diagnosing and resolving issues across the supported application stack and coordinating with vendors and other IT teams as needed.
  
3\. Engineering \& Customization — Build and maintain customizations to meet business requirements — including SuiteScript/SuiteFlow (NetSuite), Power Automate/Graph API automations (Microsoft 365\), workflow and scripting configuration (Atlassian), and equivalent customizations for other supported applications.
  
4\. Integrations \& Automation — Develop and support integrations between applications using APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tooling, building automations that reduce manual effort and improve reliability.
  
5\. Change, Release \& Patch Management — Plan, test, and execute upgrades, patches, and configuration changes across supported applications, minimizing disruption to the business.
  
6\. Security \& Compliance — Apply access control, licensing, and data\-handling practices aligned with company security policy and relevant regulatory and quality requirements.
  
7\. Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement — Monitor application health, usage, and performance; proactively identify issues and recommend and implement improvements.
  
8\. Vendor \& Stakeholder Coordination — Liaise with software vendors and business stakeholders on support cases, licensing, and roadmap requests for supported platforms.
  
9\. Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing — Maintain runbooks, configuration standards, and knowledge base articles; participate in knowledge transfer and cross\-training to build coverage across the application portfolio.
  
10\. AI \& Automation Adoption — Identify and pilot opportunities to apply AI\-assisted tooling, agents, and low\-code automation to improve support efficiency and business workflows.
  
11\. Roadmap Support — Contribute to application\-specific roadmaps for releases, improvements, and vendor\-provided enhancements, in partnership with the IT Application Operations Manager.
  
  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ATTRIBUTES
  
  

**Essential:**  

1\. NetSuite — Administration and configuration; SuiteScript 2\.x and SuiteFlow; saved searches/SuiteAnalytics; SuiteTalk and REST API integrations.
  
2\. Microsoft 365 — Administration of Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, and Entra ID (Azure AD); familiarity with Intune and the Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps).
  
3\. Box — Content management administration, permissions and governance, and API\-based integrations.
  
4\. Atlassian — Administration and configuration of Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence, including workflow design and scripting (e.g., ScriptRunner).
  
5\. APIs \& Integrations — Working knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks, and low\-code/iPaaS tools (e.g., Power Automate, N8N, Boomi) for connecting applications.
  
6\. Scripting \& Automation — Proficiency in at least one scripting language (JavaScript, PowerShell, or Python) for customization, troubleshooting, and automation.
  
7\. Application Lifecycle Management — Experience with patching, upgrades, testing, and change management for SaaS/cloud and on\-premise applications.
  
8\. Security \& Compliance Awareness — Understanding of access management, data protection, and relevant compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GxP where applicable).
  
9\. ITSM \& Monitoring Tools — Familiarity with ticketing/ITSM tooling (e.g., Jira Service Management) and application monitoring/observability tools.
  
  

**Desirable:**  

1\. Clear and effective communication with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
  
2\. Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills.
  
3\. Good organizational and time\-management skills across competing priorities.
  
4\. Ability to document clearly and concisely for varied audiences.
  
5\. Adaptability and resilience amid changing priorities and technologies.
  
6\. Effective cross\-team collaboration with Infrastructure, Security, Automation, and Business Analyst teams.
  
  

Why Signant Health?
  
At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
  
  

We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
  
  

If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
  
  

\#LI\-AB1
  
  

At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all candidates are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
  
Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

title: Engineer Manager
description:
**About GoPaisa**

GoPaisa is a profitable, founder\-led consumer technology company built over 10\+ years with a long\-term mindset. We are now building the next phase of our payments platform, with the ambition to scale toward $1B\+ in annual transaction volume across payments, rewards and financial services.

We believe in building like enduring companies such as Zerodha: capital\-efficient, customer\-focused and designed to compound over decades.

**The role**

We are looking for an Engineering Manager who combines strong backend engineering depth with the ability to lead and develop a high\-quality engineering team.

This is not a management\-only role. You will remain close to architecture, code, systems design and production problem\-solving, while also owning hiring, mentoring, execution and engineering standards.

You will work directly with the founders and can grow into broader engineering leadership as the company scales.

**What you will own**

* Build and scale backend systems for payments and transactions
* Design reliable APIs and external partner integrations
* Strengthen reconciliation, settlements and exception management
* Build risk, fraud and transaction\-monitoring capabilities
* Improve analytics, reporting and data infrastructure
* Own architecture, code reviews and production reliability
* Lead, mentor and hire engineers
* Improve engineering velocity without compromising quality
* Make GoPaisa an AI\-native engineering organisation

**AI\-native engineering**

We want AI embedded across how software is built and operated. This is not an AI branding exercise. You will help define how AI materially improves engineering quality, speed and operating leverage.

* Coding and refactoring
* Automated testing
* Code review
* Documentation
* Incident investigation
* Log and anomaly analysis
* Risk and fraud intelligence
* Workflow automation
* Analytics and reporting

**What we are looking for?**

* 6\-10 years of software\-engineering experience
* Strong backend, platform or distributed\-systems depth
* Experience leading engineers or technical workstreams
* Current hands\-on coding and architecture involvement
* Experience with APIs, databases, cloud infrastructure and production systems
* Strong ownership and sound technical judgment
* Comfort working directly with founders
* Interest in payments, data, risk and AI\-native engineering
* Experience in fintech, payments, consumer internet, marketplaces or high\-scale product companies is valuable, but not mandatory.
* Academic pedigree is welcome, but evidence of building difficult systems matters more.

Pay: ₹1,800,000\.00 \- ₹2,500,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

* Current CTC?
* Expected CTC?

* Software Engineering: 6 years (Required)
